criteria.note: Ran guardrail_runner.py rules.json over fixtures/pass: exit 0, printed 'guardrail: clean (2 rule(s) hold)'. The pass tree genuinely satisfies every rule including the repository layer that imports db - proven load-bearing: removing the exclude from the rule flags repository/user_repo.py:2, so the pass depends on the exclude allowance, not on a vacuous scan.

Ran the same rules over fixtures/fail: exit 1, printed 'service/user_service.py:7: no-db-import-outside-repository: \'import db\''. scan() genuinely opens files and matches (only the fail tree's added import db produces the violation), reports real file:line, and honors the exclude - repository/user_repo.py also contains import db yet is NOT flagged.

load_rules raises ValueError on a rule missing pattern (crafted rules.json), and run() returns exit 2 ('invalid rules file'); empty rules list and an unterminated regex also fail loud (exit 2 via ValueError/re.error). It can never silently scan nothing and pass green. python3 scripts/selftest.py = 161 passed / 0 failed; the guardrail block covers loud-load-failure (rejects rule missing its pattern), right-line violation (dirty.py line 2), exclude honoring, and exit 1-on-violation / 0-once-clean over a synthetic temp tree, stdlib only. Verified root-level .py files are scanned too (no vacuous gap).

.warp/capabilities.yaml marks static_guardrail_runner status: reference (not mechanical); the entry is byte-identical between .warp/capabilities.yaml and plugin/templates/.warp/capabilities.yaml (diff clean). Runner + fixtures + README are generic: grep for bcengi/dejitech/travelpass/workpass/coreconnect/dmitry/mvne/etc returns nothing. template sync: pass.

findings.text: The second fixture rule (no-legacy-global-singleton / GLOBAL_STATE) never fires in either fixture; it only demonstrates a multi-rule config and the rule count. Not a defect - the db-import rule fully exercises scan, exclude, and file:line reporting.

A well-formed rule whose glob matches zero files (e.g. a glob typo) would still pass green - the runner cannot distinguish a legitimately-empty scope from a typo. This is an acknowledged limitation of a line-oriented regex guardrail; AC3 only claims MALFORMED rules fail loud, which holds. Not blocking.
